metadata.selection: train-only grouped OOF F1 at .65, then Brier and AP

quality.caveat: Synthetic scenarios are not independent real-world observations. Cosine proximity is a review flag, not proof of label equivalence.

signals.reason: Too few independent annotated examples for production integration.

production.reason: Independent acceptance data and semantic-overlap review required; no automatic promotion.

rejected_architectures.MLP: 260 synthetic development rows do not justify higher capacity
rejected_architectures.gradient_boosting: No evidence axis-aligned embedding splits justify complexity

cost_policy: False negatives risk missed scams; false positives cause warning fatigue. Threshold sweeps are descriptive only.
limitations: Noise probes are paired simulated text
Artificial prevalence does not establish fraud probabilities
